j.xm1.vco1_cv.lfo@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) no longer follows the keys: its pitch rises and falls with the LFO, one octave for each full step of the signal, and every key plays the same note.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.audio@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) no longer follows the keys: its pitch is set by oscillator 1, one octave for each full step of the signal, and every key plays the same note.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.noise@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) no longer follows the keys: its pitch is set by the noise generator, one octave for each full step of the signal, and every key plays the same note.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.fast@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) no longer follows the keys: its pitch is set by the fast LFO, one octave for each full step of the signal, and every key plays the same note.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.env@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) no longer follows the keys: its pitch follows the shape of the envelope, one octave for each full step of the signal, and every key plays the same note.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.kbd@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) now plays the notes carried by the keyboard pitch instead of XM1’s own. From the other module’s CV output, both modules play the same notes whatever ASSIGN says.
j.xm1.vco1_cv.kbd2@init: VCO 1 (and VCO 2 as well, unless VCO 2 CV has its own cable) now plays the notes carried by the upper voice instead of XM1’s own. From the other module’s CV output, both modules play the same notes whatever ASSIGN says.
